# Now let me retrieve all phone contacts. I'll paginate through them.
phone_token = phone_login["access_token"]
venmo_token = venmo_login["access_token"]

all_phone_contacts = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    all_phone_contacts.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total phone contacts: {len(all_phone_contacts)}")
for c in all_phone_contacts:
    print(c.get("first_name"), c.get("last_name"), c.get("phone_number"), c.get("email"))
